invariants.statement: Clone runtime requests remain same-origin loopback/local assets only.
acceptance_obligations: Clone runtime requests remain same-origin loopback/local assets only.

invariants.statement: No real health information, source credentials, payment data or external messages are accepted or stored.
acceptance_obligations: No real health information, source credentials, payment data or external messages are accepted or stored.

invariants.statement: Any local account/session state is isolated to site_id betterhelp and its own runtime database.
acceptance_obligations: Any local account/session state is isolated to site_id betterhelp and its own runtime database.

invariants.statement: Observed public navigation routes resolve locally with meaningful content and no placeholder anchors.
acceptance_obligations: Observed public navigation routes resolve locally with meaningful content and no placeholder anchors.

invariants.statement: Shared header, hero, content sections, consent and footer adapt at desktop/tablet/mobile anchors.
acceptance_obligations: Shared header, hero, content sections, consent and footer adapt at desktop/tablet/mobile anchors.

invariants.statement: Synthetic account, intake, saved-provider, booking and management state persist across refresh and process restart within the site-scoped database.
acceptance_obligations: Persist verified local state across refresh and restart.

invariants.statement: Registration, password-reset and booking-confirmation messages are written only to the local outbox adapter and never sent externally.
Payment uses deterministic local approved, declined and retryable scenarios and never loads Stripe or accepts real payment credentials.
acceptance_obligations: Immutable booking facts are checked before approval.

invariants.statement: A second synthetic member cannot read or mutate another member's intake, saved providers, bookings, messages or payment attempts.
